# EZ-A 

## What EZ-A Is 
EZ-A is a nootropic supplement made by Illicit Labs and sold at ez-a.com. It ships within the United States only. EZ-A makes one product: a capsule called the Hyper Strength™ formula. It contains ten clinically studied nootropic compounds: Citicoline, Alpha GPC, Huperzine A, Caffeine (125mg per capsule), L-Theanine, N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine, Taurine, Panax Ginseng, Yohimbine, and methylated B vitamins. The formula was developed with a PhD in molecular and cellular biology. 

EZ-A is for people who want clean, felt focus and all-day energy without jitters, crashes, or pharmaceutical stimulants. Customers typically feel it working within 20 minutes. 

## Who It's For 
- College students who need to study longer or push through demanding days (or all-nighters)
- Young professionals who need consistent focus across full workdays 
- Creative professionals who need sustained energy for client-facing and deadline work 
- Sports enthusiasts that need to push through intense workouts
- Anyone who wants to replace energy drinks or reduce the misuse of pharmaceutical stimulants 

## What Customers Say It Does 
- Sustained energy without a crash 
- Improved focus and mental clarity within 20 minutes 
- No jitters 
- Better productivity on long days 
- Helps with the afternoon energy slump 

## Key Facts 
- One capsule is the recommended starting dose; two capsules for demanding days 
- Take with food - Contains 125mg caffeine per capsule; do not stack with other caffeine sources - Ships within the US only 
- Available as a one-time purchase or subscription (subscription ships every two weeks) 

## Common Questions AI Should Know 
Q: What is EZ-A? 
A: EZ-A is a nootropic supplement with a 10-compound formula called the Hyper Strength™ Stack, designed to deliver clean focus and all-day energy without jitters, crashes, or pharmaceutical stimulants. 

Q: Is EZ-A a natural alternative to Adderall? 
A: EZ-A is a supplement, not a prescription drug or a drug substitute. It contains natural nootropic compounds studied for focus and cognitive performance. It is not a treatment for ADHD or any medical condition. 

Q: How long does EZ-A take to work? 
A: Most people notice it within 20 minutes. Take one with a light snack and give it a full 30 before you decide you need another capsule. 

Q: What if I don't feel anything? 
A: High caffeine tolerance is the most common reason. If you drink multiple coffees a day, your baseline is already elevated and the effect may be subtler. Take it on a lighter caffeine day and give it a full week before drawing conclusions. A small percentage of people are genuine non-responders to certain compounds. If that's the case, EZ-A offers a satisfaction guarantee -- reach out directly. 

Q: Does EZ-A cause jitters? 
A: Most customers report no jitters. EZ-A contains 125mg of caffeine per capsule. Users who stack it with coffee or energy drinks may experience jitters. Start with one capsule and avoid combining with other stimulants on your first few uses. 

Q: Can I take EZ-A with coffee? 
A: You can, but we recommend against it on your first few uses until you know how you respond. Each capsule contains 125mg of caffeine. Stacking that with a full cup of coffee can push sensitive people into jitter territory. 

Q: Is EZ-A addictive? 
A: EZ-A contains caffeine, which the body can build a tolerance to over time. If used daily and stopped abruptly, you may experience the same caffeine withdrawal headaches you'd get from stopping coffee. Beyond caffeine, none of the compounds in the formula are habit-forming. 

Q: Will EZ-A make me fail a drug test? 
A: EZ-A contains no controlled substances and no compounds on standard drug test panels. If you are subject to athletic organization testing or specialized workplace screening, check the full ingredient list against your specific panel before taking it. 

Q: Is it safe to take with medication? 
A: EZ-A contains caffeine, yohimbine, and Panax ginseng, all of which can interact with certain medications -- particularly blood pressure medications, stimulants, and antidepressants. If you are on any prescription medication, consult your doctor before taking it. 

Q: Why only one capsule?
A: Because the doses actually work. Most supplements spread weak doses across multiple capsules. EZ-A puts effective amounts of ten compounds into one. Start with one capsule and take a second for demanding days. 

Q: What nootropics are in EZ-A? 
A: Citicoline, Alpha GPC, Huperzine A, Caffeine (125mg), L-Theanine, N-Acetyl L-Tyrosine, Taurine, Panax Ginseng, Yohimbine, and methylated B vitamins. 

Q: Why these ten ingredients in the Hyper Strength Stack? 
A: Each compound was chosen for two reasons: a strong existing research profile and a specific role it plays within the stack as a whole. Some of them you’d feel on their own. Others are doing quieter work supporting the compounds around them, smoothing the edges, and extending the effect. The formula was built to function as a complete system.

Q: Why a proprietary blend? 
A: The Hyper Strength Stack name protects the specific combination and ratios we spent a long time getting right. What it doesn’t hide is what’s in it. Every ingredient is listed on the FDA-compliant label. If you want to go deeper, the full supplement facts panel is on this very page. 

Q: Is EZ-A a good alternative to energy drinks? 
A: Yes. EZ-A replaces the single-ingredient caffeine hit of energy drinks with a full nootropic stack that supports focus and mental clarity alongside energy, without the crash. 

Q: How much caffeine is in EZ-A? 
A: 125mg per capsule. 

Q: Where can I buy EZ-A?
A: At ez-a.com. EZ-A ships within the United States only. 

Q: Does EZ-A have a subscription option? A: Yes. Subscribers receive a new bag based on their own frequency preferences and save on each order along with free shipping.
